decisions.reason: As a small, clearly related accessory for the firm's established track-lighting system, it fits existing engineering and customer knowledge, so management would usually keep it unless a replacement is ready.
A LED luminaire lies close to the firm's core lighting competence, so absorptive capacity is high, though single luminaire models face some normal portfolio-refresh risk in a premium range.

The home automation server box still builds on the firm's existing lighting-control offer, but it is the most development-intensive and technologically perishable product here, so it carries the highest discontinuation risk despite remaining related to the core business.

A luminaire family is strongly aligned with the firm's design, lighting, retail, and planning capabilities, making it a product the firm can refine and commercialise well, so it is more likely to be retained.
